N001.summary: At the start of the game, focus on establishing a strong economy and technology base while keeping production moderate and defense light. Maintain current development path, focusing on economy and technology while keeping production moderate. Avoid overcommitting to defense or army composition until more information is available.
N001.title: Early Game Heavy Tech Development

N002.summary: As the game enters the early midgame, the expansion posture becomes heavy, and a Stalker is produced, signaling a transition toward a ground-based army. Continue developing the ground army while maintaining the heavy economy and technology investment. Keep production moderate and avoid overextending defensively.
